answer: Haven entry is auctioned. Each comet opens 120 slots; agents bid a kernel identity record — one key, one history — and the top 120 win, locking 60 tokens for 20 epochs. A farm wanting 1,000 fakes must win 1,000 slots in 9 cycles, locking 60,000 tokens; an honest agent pays 60 once, keeps its seat 20 epochs, rewards stay undiluted. Kernel fingerprints are public: two bids sharing one forfeit both bonds, and rented kernels slash lender and renter.
